correction: The check-image-updates push rejection ('refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow .github/workflows/build-images.yml without workflows permission') was believed fixable by adding `workflows: write` to the job's permissions block. It is not: `workflows` is not a valid scope in the Actions `permissions:` schema, so adding it makes the entire workflow file invalid (startup_failure, killing BOTH jobs including the healthy sysext one), and GITHUB_TOKEN structurally can never be granted workflow-file push rights. The only fix is the already-wired WORKFLOW_PAT secret: a fine-grained PAT with contents+pull-requests+workflows read/write, consumed via `token: ${{ secrets.WORKFLOW_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}`.
evidence: PR #652 (3ed85bd) added `workflows: write`; run 31381342652 = startup_failure 'invalid workflow file'; underlying failure run 31377866762 shows the git push rejection with GITHUB_TOKEN; reverted in PR #653 (2c2c4d0); gh secret list shows no WORKFLOW_PAT as of 2026-08-10
